## You must change `tests/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [tests/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at

## Evidence — verified finding

```
rbops/dispatch.sh:442-447 admits it in prose and nothing measures it, so the number can only grow silently: 'six of them are in redblue's history today, carrying unreviewed code.' Measured this audit: `git -C redblue log --oneline main | grep checkpoint` prints 4 lines - 7fdea15 and 074c95e `rbops: phase-019 checkpoint`, 563a351 `rbops: phase-018 checkpoint`, 286fccd `rbops: phase-016 checkpoint` - and `git -C redblue log --oneline main | grep -c "Merge remote-tracking branch"` prints 4, the real `git merge` commits that put them there (e97983a, d664d3c, 2179034, 255816e). rbops/dispatch.sh:439-486 now resumes with `git merge --squash`, so the recurrence path is closed and this is a measurement that has never existed, not a live bug. phase-051 is a different defect (uncommitted work, not ancestry) and does not cover it.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Add an executable check that fails when any `rbops: phase-NNN checkpoint` commit that is an ancestor of redblue main is not on a hand-maintained acknowledgement list, and record in the repository that the four existing ones carry unreviewed code and were not rewritten.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-078
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] a Rust test shells out to `git log --oneline main` in this repository, selects every commit whose subject matches `rbops: phase-[0-9]+ checkpoint`, and fails naming any SHA that is not in a checked-in acknowledgement list; an edge_* test feeds the selector a fixture history containing one unlisted SHA and asserts the check fails
- [ ] run against redblue main as it stands the test passes, and the list it reports contains all four measured SHAs (7fdea15, 074c95e, 563a351, 286fccd) each with the reason it is tolerated - the list is data in the repository, not a comment
- [ ] the same test counts `Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/rbops-wip/*'` commits on main (4 today) and prints the count, so a recurrence through a different resume path is visible rather than silent
- [ ] a record in the test module states plainly that the four checkpoint commits carry unreviewed code, that published history was deliberately NOT rewritten, and that no force-push is attempted by this phase or any gate
- [ ] on a shallow or absent history the test never reports a pass: it prints the reason it could not read the full history and fails, rather than treating a short log as a clean one
- [ ] `cargo test` reports 0 failures and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean with no `allow(` added and no `#[ignore]`
